ai_summary: AXISCADES Technologies Limited is undertaking the voluntary solvent liquidation of its German step-down subsidiary, add solution GmbH, due to continuous losses and a negative net worth stemming from a downturn in the automotive industry. While the subsidiary contributed only 1.35% to AXISCADES' turnover, its negative net worth of -1.96% signals it was a financial drain. The parent company expects no material impact on its operations or profitability, implying the elimination of a loss-making entity is a rationalization step aimed at improving overall financial health.
